$comment: Desired GitHub state. Consumed by scripts/github/configure-repository.mjs — GitHub does NOT read this file. Edit here, then run the script to apply and verify.

pullRequest.$comment: The single, durable target policy. configure-repository.mjs applies it verbatim when the repository has at least 2 eligible reviewers (collaborators with write/admin). With only 1, it applies a bootstrap exception (0 approvals, last-push approval off) and reports why — no edit here is needed when a second maintainer is added through GitHub access; just re-run the script.

requiredStatusChecks.$comment: Exact check-run (job) names. doNotEnforceOnCreate lets `cut-release-line` create release/vX.Y (a non-PR push, so no checks can have run on it) while still gating every later push.
